mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies near Harriet Park with a temperature of 67 degrees and an air quality index of 51. We are under a New Moon, and tonight will see an overnight low of 63 degrees with no rain predicted.

City Hall reports that our police department is currently accepting applications for their Citizen Academy, a free nine-week program covering everything from traffic stops to O W I investigations. Also, please note that election notices for the November general election have been posted.

We have a busy couple of days ahead with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company today. Tomorrow, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market in Madison or catch live music at Paddy Mac's, and don't forget the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival coming up on September 13th.
On September 10th, officers were dispatched to Hunter's Cove Way for a burglary in progress where a suspect was apprehended with a handgun, and thankfully, no injuries were reported.
Today's delicious flavor is Raspberry Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently open but will be closing soon in 23 minutes, so please plan your visit accordingly.
